999008199.text:
しかし、昔は我関せずという感じだったお前さんが
九偉人の問題を解決したいと言い出すとはねえ……

localizations.en: Still, to think you'd want to solve the Nine's problems... You used to be so indifferent to everything.

999008199.text:
昔の私は知らないけど……
多分一緒に暮らしている家族の影響なんだと思う

localizations.en: I don't remember the old me, but... I think it's probably the influence of the family I've been living with.

999008199.text:
まあねえ。おっさんやフロッケと一緒に居ると、
もっと成長しなきゃって思っちゃうよね

localizations.en: Yeah, I get that. When you're around the old man and Flocke, you can't help but want to improve yourself.

999008199.text:
もちろん、一番はハイディ、あんたの影響よ。
記憶を失っても、相棒としてそばで支えてくれた

localizations.en: Of course, you're the biggest influence, Heidi. Even after I lost my memories, you stayed by my side and supported me as my partner.

999008199.text:
お、おう……そう正面から言われると……
照れちゃうよ……はは

localizations.en: O-oh... When you put it so directly like that... it's kinda embarrassing... haha.

999008199.text:
ああ……いい仲間に巡り合えたんだね。
これからも大切にしてやりなよ

localizations.en: Ah... You've found some good companions. Make sure you treasure them.

999008199.text:
はーい……そうだ、昔の私ってどんなだったの？
我関せずって、ヘルトみたいに自由気ままな感じ？

localizations.en: I will... Oh, what was I like before? When you say indifferent, was I free-spirited like Held?

999008199.text:
まぁ、自分の動きたいように動くって意味では
ヘル兄と少し似ているかもね

localizations.en: Well, in the sense that you moved however you wanted, you were a bit similar to Held.

999008199.text: 似ていると言われると、少しショックだわ

localizations.en: Being compared to him is kind of shocking.

999008199.text: ははは、まぁヴァレリアは威張ったりはしないから

localizations.en: Hahaha, well, at least you weren't arrogant like him.

999008199.text: 戦って、食べて、寝て……そんな感じさ

localizations.en: Fight, eat, sleep... that was about it.

999008199.text:
そうなのね……うーむ我ながら、
あんまり兄弟愛とかなかったのかしら

localizations.en: I see... Hmm, I wonder if I didn't really have much sisterly affection back then.

999008199.text:
でも今は、キューンが心配なのよ？
ヘルトとゼロに逆らえないだろうし

localizations.en: But now I'm worried about Quinn, you know? She can't go against Held and Zero.

999008199.text:
ああ、ヴァレリアはキューンとヤドヴィガについては
妹だからか、昔から結構気にかけてたね

localizations.en: Yeah, you always cared quite a bit about Quinn and Jadwiga, probably because they're your younger sisters.

999008199.text:
ヤドヴィガはいつも肌出してるから、
風邪ひくよって服着せようとしてた

localizations.en: You'd try to get Jadwiga to put on clothes because she was always showing so much skin and you worried she'd catch cold.

999008199.text: おっ、なんかお姉ちゃんじゃ～ん

localizations.en: Ooh, sounds like you were a real big sister!

999008199.text:
からかわないの！
でも、確かにお姉ちゃんしてたんだ

localizations.en: Don't tease me! But I guess I really was acting like a big sister.

999008199.text:
キューンが嫌いな野菜を、
こっそり代わりに食べてやってたこともあったね

localizations.en: You even secretly ate the vegetables Quinn didn't like for her.

999008199.text:
ああ、あれそうだったんだ。
てっきり足らなくて奪ってたのかと

localizations.en: Oh, so that's what that was. I thought you were just taking them because you didn't have enough.

999008199.text: 失礼な！　ちゃんと許可取ってもらってたのよ、多分！

localizations.en: How rude! I'm sure I got permission first... probably!

999008199.text:
……ねえ、ヘルトとゼロが旅行をしている間、
私たちの監視はヤドヴィガとキューンになるわよね？

localizations.en: ...Hey, while Held and Zero are traveling, Jadwiga and Quinn will be the ones watching us, right?

999008199.text:
そのときに、隙を見て二人を説得したいの。
イェルカ、シトリン、協力してくれる？

localizations.en: When that happens, I want to find an opening to persuade them. Jelka, Citrine, will you help me?

999008199.text: もちろん。アタシはずっとお前さんたちの味方だよ

localizations.en: Of course. I'll always be on your side.

999008199.text:
僕はずっと味方か分かんないけどね。ただまあ、
おっかないヘルトに付きっきりは可哀そうだし

localizations.en: I can't say I'll always be on your side, but... well, I do feel bad that they're stuck with scary Held all the time.

999008199.text:
向こうの陣営から引き抜くことで
ヘルト側の戦力を下げるのはいい案だと思う

localizations.en: Pulling them away from their side would weaken Held's forces too, so I think it's a good plan.

999008199.text: シトリンは、ほんとヘルトのこと苦手よね？

localizations.en: You really don't like Held, do you, Citrine?

999008199.text:
まぁ、二人っきりの時に色々あったからね……
それに何より

localizations.en: Well, some things happened when we were alone together... And more than anything...

999008199.text:
僕も楽しいものが好きだけど、ヘルトと一緒にいると
楽しいより怖いが勝つんだよね

localizations.en: I like fun things too, but being around Held? The fear outweighs the fun.

999008199.text:
あんたってなんとなく、常識って不自由の中で
自由になろうとしてるように見えるしね

localizations.en: You seem like someone trying to find freedom within the constraints of common sense, you know?

999008199.text:
一方でヘルトってのは聞く限り常識に縛られない、
自分自身が法って感じの自由に思えるよ

localizations.en: Held, on the other hand, from what I've heard, isn't bound by common sense at all. He's the kind of freedom where he himself is the law.

999008199.text:
おおう、僕が常識人……そんな風に
見られていたとは驚きだ。ちょっと悔しいな

localizations.en: Whoa, being seen as someone with common sense... I'm surprised that's how I come across. That's a little frustrating.

999008199.text: そこで悔しがれるのがいいんだと思うよ

localizations.en: The fact that you'd be frustrated about it is exactly what I mean.

999008199.text: ……ヴァレリア。相棒としてあんたの願い、叶えるよ

localizations.en: ...Valeria. As your partner, I'll make your wish come true.

999008199.text: ……ええ、頼りにしてるわよ、相棒
